# Vallarta Daily

> Vallarta Daily delivers comprehensive news coverage of Puerto Vallarta and Mexico with daily updates on local events, public safety, infrastructure, politics, business, and cultural developments.

Vallarta Daily is a daily news publication focused on Puerto Vallarta and national Mexico coverage. The site provides breaking news, topic-specific hubs, and daily briefings across categories including public safety, infrastructure, politics, business, culture, and events.

## Key Topics

- Puerto Vallarta
- Mexico News
- Public Safety
- Infrastructure
- Politics
- Business & Economy
- Events & Festivals
- Real Estate
- Transportation
- Healthcare
- Culture & Traditions
- Environment & Wildlife
- Courts & Justice
- Cabo Corrientes
- Malecón

## News Hubs

- [Homepage](https://www.vallartadaily.com): Main news hub for Puerto Vallarta and Mexico daily coverage
- [Puerto Vallarta News Today](https://www.vallartadaily.com/pvr-news): Daily Puerto Vallarta news with local headlines and breaking updates
- [Mexico News Today](https://www.vallartadaily.com/mexico-news): National Mexico news covering politics, economy, security, and culture

## Public Safety & Security

- [Public Safety News, Trends, and Regional Reports](https://www.vallartadaily.com/topic/mexico-crime): Public safety and crime news: policing, fire, rescue, and prevention
- [Cabo Corrientes Wildfire Burns Past 2,000 Hectares](https://www.vallartadaily.com/puerto-vallarta-news/cabo-corrientes-wildfire-burns-past-2000-hectares): Cabo Corrientes wildfire coverage: 2,000+ hectares burned, smoke alerts

- [Infrastructure and Utilities News](https://www.vallartadaily.com/topic/infrastructure): Infrastructure coverage: water, power, internet, waste, and outages

- [Puerto Vallarta Malecón Expansion Delayed to March 27](https://www.vallartadaily.com/puerto-vallarta-news/puerto-vallarta-malecon-expansion-delayed-to-march-27): Puerto Vallarta Malecón expansion project update and construction delay

## Government, Politics & Policy
